purpose: Descriptive full-native-category audit of previously exposed bottle category; no tuning or untouched-test claim

figure_rule.true_negative: lowest hybrid score among native normals below locked cutoff
figure_rule.false_positive: highest hybrid score among native normals at/above locked cutoff
figure_rule.smallest_defect: smallest positive cropped mask pixel count among native anomalies
figure_rule.miss: lowest hybrid score among native anomalies below locked cutoff
figure_rule.localization_failure: lowest hybrid pixel IoU at locked pixel cutoff among native anomalies with nonempty cropped mask
figure_rule.tie_break: lexicographic sample ID; deduplicate rows but preserve all selection reasons; absent event explicitly reported

display_rule: One shared min/max across both baseline and hybrid maps across all 83 images, same bounds for all normal and anomalous rows. Delta has its own explicitly labeled shared range. Original local/global PNGs are display scalings of hybrid only.

intervals.resampling_unit: query image, stratified by native normal/anomalous label; paired methods use identical sampled indices
intervals.scope: Conditional on this fitted bank/support image and known category; excludes support draw, training and category uncertainty
intervals.au_pro: 8-connected equal-region PRO, pooled normal-pixel FPR, integrated to .3; fixed 128 distinct-score rank thresholds from original full cohort plus +/-inf, same as point estimate; bootstrap reweights image-level sufficient statistics at this fixed grid; approximate sampled-threshold interval, not adaptive-grid bootstrap

metric_scope: Native image labels with center-crop-derived image scores; all pixel metrics on 392/448 center ROI resized to256x256, outer borders unscored
